# Hindustan Projects (HiPRO)
> Engineering, Turnkey Construction, and Infrastructure firm based in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, India. Founded in 2019.

## Overview
Hindustan Projects (HiPRO) is an engineering, civil construction, and infrastructure firm headquartered in Bhilwara, Rajasthan. Established in 2019 under the leadership of Founder & Director Yogesh Kharol, the firm delivers architectural planning, disciplined turnkey civil execution, precision surveying, interior design, industrial water treatment plant construction, and project management consultancy.

## Leadership & Organization
- Brand Name: Hindustan Projects (HiPRO)
- Legal Name: Hindustan Projects
- Founder: Yogesh Kharol — Founder & Director
- Founded: 2019
- Headquarters: Opposite Mukherji Park, Above Bhagwati Coffee House, Bhopal Ganj, Bhilwara, Rajasthan 311001, India

## Canonical Practice Areas & Services
- Architecture & Planning: Master planning, 2D/3D architectural drafting, elevation design, structural drawings, and municipal sanction coordination.
- Professional Construction Services: Turnkey residential, commercial, and industrial civil construction with disciplined quality control and milestone execution.
- Surveying & Site Measurements: Topographical surveys, boundary demarcation, contour mapping, and digital site measurements using Total Station and modern surveying instruments.
- Interior & Exterior Design: Spatial planning, bespoke residential and commercial interior fit-outs, material curation, and facade design.
- Water Treatment Plant Construction: Civil construction and engineering for industrial Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), and water treatment infrastructure.
- Project Management & Consultancy: Site supervision, project scheduling, quality auditing, contractor coordination, and construction consultancy.

## Tools & Resources
- Instant Cost Estimator: Free interactive construction cost estimator providing package-based estimates for residential construction in Rajasthan (https://www.hindustanprojects.in/cost-estimator).
- Insights & Knowledge Base: Practical engineering and construction guides covering construction costs, architectural planning, and local bylaws in Rajasthan (https://www.hindustanprojects.in/blogs).
